edits.value: Spec review against NHIA/BLI 3-in-1 batch enrolment format (01_Apply3Of1, rev. 115.03.11): field mappings, C/M/O, data types and Report Matrix updated; 'New Specification' tab (withholding tax) removed.
Employee level: one row per new hire (投保者 = 1) plus one row per NHI dependant (投保者 = 2).

New hires enrolled by the same unit in LI(+EI)/OAI, LP and NHI (投保別 2) or in OAI, LP and NHI (投保別 4). Excluded (guide 01_Apply3Of1, rev. 115.03.11, note to field 6): NHI-only enrolments and enrolment of foreign (外籍) employees, for whom LI and NHI are filed separately (NHI with NHIA). Whether codes 1/2/L of field 7 are also excluded: TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA.

File on the hire date (到職當日). LI/EI coverage starts at 00:00 on the filing date; if not filed on the hire date, from the next day (BLI form 承表D rev. 115.01, note 2). NHI starts on the day the enrolment conditions are met. Electronic batch: Excel upload in the NHIA multi-certificate system; the official guide defines column order, values and notes only (no start/end positions, no official TXT layout).
C = Conditional, M = Mandatory, O = Optional

$legal_entity_hr.labor_insure_id - first 8 characters, as text (keep leading zeros). DD V3.3 types this field as Number although the 9th character is a letter: TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA (DD also has insurance_certification_number, '8 digits + 1 text').
Employee row: $hr.si_enrollment_code::key (2 or 4). Dependant row: "3" (as in the official sample) - TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA. Pay elements 58140/58120/2517/2560 are not used.
Employee row: "1"; dependant row: "2". $hr.number_of_nhi_dependents = number of dependant rows to generate for the employee. 58212 (tax dependants) is not used.

※ If field 5 = "4" (OAI/LP/NHI), field 27 must be filled.
※ NHI-only changes, or enrolment of foreign (外籍) employees (LI and NHI filed separately): file with NHIA.
※ Pay below the minimum wage (e.g. part-time): fill the special identity (field 13).

"Y": Foreigner
"1": Foreign spouse (incl. Hong Kong/Macau spouse)
"2": Mainland Chinese spouse
"L": Permanent-resident foreign professional (永居外專)
Blank: Taiwanese nationality

Employee nationality: no field in DD V3.3 -> NEW DD FIELD (proposed): Employee Nationality (+ permanent-resident foreign professional flag for 'L'); TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA. Logic: nationality = TW -> blank; permanent-resident foreign professional (永居外專) -> 'L'; $hr.spouse_nationality = TW and nationality = CN -> '2'; $hr.spouse_nationality = TW and other nationality (incl. Hong Kong/Macau) -> '1'; otherwise 'Y'. Do not use $hr.residential_status (tax residency).

被保險人身分證號
(居留證統一證號/護照號碼)

For Taiwanese, enter the national ID no.
For foreigners, enter the ARC unified ID no. or passport no.

IF(EQUALS($hr.id_type::key; '3'); $hr.passport_number; $hr.id_card_number) - nationals: national ID; foreigners: ARC unified ID number (id_type 2) or passport (id_type 3), the same ID used at enrolment. Replaces $hr.residential_status (tax residency).
Chinese names: nationals at least 2 characters, foreigners at least 1. English names: full name in full-width uppercase letters. Maximum 200 characters.

Nationals: Chinese name (ID Information field 'name' 名字). Foreigners with English names: UPPERCASE full name converted to full-width characters (e.g. ＤＡＶＩＤ), max. 200 characters. Full-width conversion function: TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA.

月薪資總額
[勞(就)保/災保/勞退]
※ BLI classifies it into the LI, OAI and LP band tables after receiving the file

TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA: HR field holding the agreed monthly wage at hire (no payroll result exists at the hire event); if none exists -> NEW DD FIELD (proposed): Monthly wage total at hire. Must include all regular pay for work (base salary, monthly allowances incl. meal allowance, attendance/performance bonuses) and exclude year-end/assessment bonuses, festival bonuses and profit sharing (BLI page 0022929; NHIA insured-amount guide; LSA Enforcement Rules art. 10). 58008/58009/6220% are not used.

$hr.nhi_grade::orLabel (same base as WTC 64550; pay element 58139 does not exist in WTC V2.8). Validation: not lower than the LI/EI/OAI insured salary and the LP contribution wage (BLI form 承表D instr. 9(3)).

Dependant row: $hr.id_card_number_dependent_N (national dependants only); employee row: blank. NEW DD FIELD (proposed): id_card_number_dependent_4..6 (DD V3.3 has ID/name/birthday for dependants 1-3 but relationship for 1-6). Non-national dependants: TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA.
Dependant row: $hr.name_dependent_N; employee row: blank. NEW DD FIELD (proposed): name_dependent_4..6.

Dependant row: CONCAT(PREPAD(SUBTRACT(DATE_FORMAT($hr.birthday_dependent_N; 'yyyy'); 1911); 3; '0'); DATE_FORMAT($hr.birthday_dependent_N; 'MMdd')); employee row: blank. NEW DD FIELD (proposed): birthday_dependent_4..6.
Dependant row: $hr.dependent_N_relationship::key (1-9); employee row: blank. The batch does not accept 'P' (ward, present in the DD mapper): such dependants TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA.

Self:
"1": Employment start
"2": Union membership
Dependent:
"4": Affiliated coverage
"5": Change in status
"6": Marriage
"7": Adoption
"8": Newborn
Special cases (dependant transferred in, aged 18 or over, relationship = 3, 5, 7):
"S": Student without job
"P": Under guardianship
"A": Disabled & unable to work
"H": Seriously ill without job
"G": Recent graduate or discharged soldier without job (within 1 year)

Employee row: "1" (到職起薪). Dependant row: $hr.adult_2_lineal_relatives_code_N::key (S, P, A, H, G) when filled; otherwise NEW DD FIELD (proposed): NHI enrolment reason per dependant (4-8) - TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA (proposal: "4").

Employee row: CONCAT(PREPAD(SUBTRACT(DATE_FORMAT($hr.health_insurance_enrollment_start_date; 'yyyy'); 1911); 3; '0'); DATE_FORMAT($hr.health_insurance_enrollment_start_date; 'MMdd')) - DD V3.3 types the field as Text: TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA. Dependant row: NEW DD FIELD (proposed): date of the dependant's enrolment reason.
IF field 7 is not blank: IF(EQUALS($person.gender; 'male'); 'M'; 'F'); otherwise blank (foreigners only). Replaces $hr.residential_status (tax residency).
Rate as an integer % (e.g. 6). Object holding it: TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA (WTC 52537 = DIVIDE($52537.amount;100), i.e. 0.06).
Rate as an integer %; blank if 0. Object holding it: TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA (WTC 52517 = DIVIDE($52517.amount;100)).

Only if the LP contribution date differs from the LI enrolment date and is 1 to 6 days before the filing date: CONCAT(PREPAD(SUBTRACT(DATE_FORMAT($hr.labor_pension_contribution_date; 'yyyy'); 1911); 3; '0'); DATE_FORMAT($hr.labor_pension_contribution_date; 'MMdd')); otherwise blank. DD V3.3 types the field as Text: TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA.
OAI-only enrolment condition (Occupational Accident Insurance; insurance type 4 only)

<勞工職業災害保險>
僅參加「災保」條件
(投保別-4專用欄位)

"1": Already received the LI old-age benefit
"2": Not received the LI old-age benefit and over 65
Blank: other cases. Mandatory when field 5 = "4".

IF field 5 = "4": $hr.received_social_insurance_benefits_type_occupational_accident::key; otherwise blank. TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA: DD mapper key 2 reads "received other social insurance benefits and over 65"; guide rev. 115.03.11 defines 2 as "not received the LI old-age benefit and over 65".
